intro: Malta's small economy has grown fast, powered by tourism, online gaming and financial services.

chapters.title: Tourism and services
text: Tourists come for the sun, sea and history, and many students come to learn English. Malta is a major base for online gaming companies, and its shipping register is one of the largest in the world.

chapters.title: On screen
text: Malta's forts and coast have appeared in films and TV series such as Gladiator and Game of Thrones.
